title: A new lower bound for the kissing number in 19 dimensions
summary: We prove that the kissing number in 19 dimensions is at least 11948, improving the bound of Cohn and Li by 256. By the odd-sign construction of Cohn and Li, it is enough to find a binary code of length 19 and minimum distance 5 inside the ambient 5-punctured extended binary Golay code. We construct such a code explicitly, of size 1280. The construction is organized around a chain of linear codes $M\le K\le D$, $|M|=64$, $|K/M|=16$, and $|D/K|=4$.
